scope: Five additional major corporate disclosures verified against SEC filings. This remains a selected dataset, not an exhaustive company census.

companies.name: Coinbase Global
companies.locator: Notes 7 and 9; units, not USD thousands
companies.evidence: Own investment assets 17,311 BTC + 150,279 ETH; own operating assets 553 BTC + 10,480 ETH. Sum: 17,864 BTC / 160,759 ETH. Borrowed assets, lending/derivatives collateral owed to counterparties and customer assets are separate categories and excluded.
companies.verdict: Add dated proprietary operating and investment assets only. US attribution follows principal executive offices in the filing.

companies.name: Sharplink
companies.locator: MD&A, total ETH holdings and liquidity; subsequent disclosure at August 3
companies.evidence: 634,255 native ETH. Exclude 181,748 ETH equivalent from LsETH and 72,935 ETH equivalent from weETH; do not use gross 888,938 ETH-equivalent figure for a native-token total.
companies.verdict: Add native ETH including native staking only. Miami headquarters. No newer native-unit breakdown located during review.

companies.name: Hut 8 (consolidated)
companies.locator: Note 4 Bitcoin and Market Price Risk of Bitcoin
companies.evidence: 17,316 BTC = 9,314 Hut 8 + 8,002 consolidated American Bitcoin. Includes 9,376 in custody, 3,090 pledged for miner purchase, 4,850 pledged as collateral. Own assets; not customer assets.
companies.verdict: Add consolidated balance once under Miami-based parent. Do not separately add American Bitcoin or mix subsidiary updates from another date.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.evidence: Explicitly discloses 11,509 units of Bitcoin at June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025. No unit count is inferred from fair value.
companies.verdict: Add dated issuer-owned BTC. Q3 results are scheduled after the review date and not used.

companies.name: Strive
companies.evidence: 29,462 BTC at October 2 versus 28,000 at September 30. Strategy preferred shares are financial investments and are not added as BTC. Consolidated group counted once.
companies.verdict: Add native BTC only. Dallas principal executive offices.
